title: I fell down running! But then I didn't cry.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I fell down running! But then I didn't cry.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Oh no! Did you get hurt?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Just a little scrape on my knee. But then it stopped hurting.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did the teacher see you fall?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes, but I didn't even need a bandage!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Roar! Tigers don't cry — they roar!

variations: "fell down" 换 "dropped my lunch"；"cry" 换 "give up"。
